business: Nota (@NotaGetBot): a Telegram bot that collects receipts, invoices and handwritten delivery notes from work chats into a Google Sheet and flags duplicates and arithmetic errors
target: Bookkeepers and small accounting firms in Bali serving 5–40 small-business clients (villas, construction, cafés, shops) who chase clients for receipts every month
where: Bali, Indonesia; mostly Indonesian and Russian-speaking bookkeepers serving foreign-owned PT PMA and local businesses

segments.name: Company-registration / PT PMA service that also does monthly bookkeeping

behaviours.name: Drowning at month end
behaviours.how: Clients send receipts late, in WhatsApp and Telegram, half missing; you spend days chasing and retyping.

behaviours.name: Runs on Jurnal / Accurate
behaviours.how: Everything must end up in the accounting system; any tool that does not export there is extra work.

behaviours.name: Bills clients by the hour
behaviours.how: Saving time only matters if you can take more clients or charge for the service.

behaviours.name: Would resell a tool
behaviours.how: You like adding a paid service on top of bookkeeping and keeping a margin.

behaviours.name: Cautious about client data
behaviours.how: Client data confidentiality and Indonesian data rules (UU PDP) matter; you avoid unknown apps.

behaviours.name: Price-sensitive freelancer
behaviours.how: Every subscription comes out of a small monthly income.

objections: One account handles only 5 groups and one sheet; I have 20 clients and need them separated
It does not export to Jurnal or Accurate and has no invoice number, VAT (PPN) or NPWP fields
Who pays, me or the client? I cannot add $19 per client to my fee
My clients will not want a bot in their group chats
If recognition is wrong, I am responsible for the books
I already have a WhatsApp routine that works
habits: you have a separate WhatsApp or Telegram chat with each client for documents
clients send a bag of crumpled nota at the end of the month
you enter documents into Jurnal or Accurate for tax reporting
you get new clients by referral from company-registration agents
you charge a fixed monthly fee per client
